originalTitle: U.S. crude oil falls nearly 8% for the week after Tehran and Washington hold talks at the U.N.
summary: Iran has asked the U.S. to meet the same conditions laid out in the June 17 memorandum of understanding, Iran's foreign minister said.
content:
U.S. crude oil posted a sharp loss for the week as Tehran and Washington held discussions on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York City.

West Texas Intermediate dropped 2.3% to close at $92.41 per barrel. Brent , the international benchmark, declined 2.1% to settle at $104.32. U.S. crude finished the week 7.9% lower while Brent was flat.

Tehran has offered to open the Strait of Hormuz in seven days if the U.S. meets the conditions in the interim peace deal reached in June, Iranian Foreign minister Abbas Araghchi told reporters Thursday at the U.N.

But the June memorandum of understanding quickly collapsed as fighting broke out over transit rights through Hormuz. It is unclear how Iran's current proposal would prevent hostilities from erupting again.

Iran will restart talks to reach a final deal if the U.S. implements the MOU conditions, Araghchi said. Tehran is waiting for a response from the U.S., the foreign minister told reporters.

"I think it would be much better if it is done before the midterm election, but it depends on the U.S. administration to decide," Araghchi told reporters. "We are not in a hurry."
chineseTitle: 德黑兰和华盛顿在联合国举行会谈后，美国原油价格本周下跌近 8%
chineseSummary: 伊朗外长表示，伊朗已要求美国满足 6 月 17 日谅解备忘录中规定的相同条件。
chineseContent:
由于德黑兰和华盛顿在纽约联合国大会间隙进行讨论，美国原油本周大幅下跌。

西德克萨斯中质原油下跌 2.3%，收于每桶 92.41 美元。国际基准布伦特原油下跌 2.1%，收于 104.32 美元。美国原油本周下跌 7.9%，而布伦特原油持平。

伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇周四在联合国对记者表示，如果美国满足6月份达成的临时和平协议中的条件，德黑兰将在7天内开放霍尔木兹海峡。

但随着霍尔木兹过境权的争夺爆发，六月份的谅解备忘录很快就破裂了。目前尚不清楚伊朗目前的提议将如何防止敌对行动再次爆发。

阿拉格奇表示，如果美国执行谅解备忘录的条件，伊朗将重启谈判以达成最终协议。德黑兰外交部长告诉记者，德黑兰正在等待美国的回应。

阿拉格奇对记者表示：“我认为如果在中期选举之前完成会好得多，但这取决于美国政府的决定。” “我们不着急。”
